meta.title: Douce Rêverie
meta.description: A free, romantic, slightly sweet closet for becoming yourself.

hero.title: Soft rituals, luminous days
hero.body: White lace, morning light, and a slower kind of time. A quiet little thrill for the everyday closet.

manifesto.label: Manifesto
lines: The older we become, the more we inherit rules about what is proper.
Let that cramped reality rest for a while, and begin the sweetest game of make-believe.
Not for anyone else, but for the part of me that wants to feel enchanted.
Frills, ribbons, vintage lace. Standing in front of the mirror becomes a spell for becoming a film heroine.
You can become anything, if that is who you want to be.
Inside an unwaking sweet daydream, Douce Rêverie, stay as willful and girlish as you like.
Wear what you love and perform the version of yourself you love.
Douce Rêverie is a free, romantic, slightly sweet charm that returns me to my eternal girlhood.
A self-affirming closet made to spoil me more than anyone else in the world.

story.title: Pieces made for quiet arrival.
story.body: Douce Rêverie builds a wardrobe for mornings, travel, and weekend promises through soft shapes, clear materials, and restrained details.

campaign.title: Dear Morning
campaign.body: A spring collection born from window light, white fabric, and a softly sweet sense of living.
